title: Towards a user-centric HPC-QC environment
problem: Hybrid HPC-QPU systems lack robust execution environment for hybrid quantum-classical programs; integration challenges in scheduling, portability, and reproducibility.
motivation: Portable runtime environment needed for hybrid quantum-classical program development in HPC with QPU integration.
method: HPC-QC middleware with second-layer scheduling post-HPC manager for QPU utilization; vendor-neutral QRMI support; monitoring and observability stack.
key_novelty: Vendor-neutral QRMI-based middleware for hybrid HPC-QPU systems; second-tier scheduling for QPU optimization.
contributions: Portable runtime for hybrid quantum-classical HPC programs
